nodes.task: Independently parse input/operations.csv (six weeks, three teams) and persist metrics.json in the required schema: row_count, totals, and per-team entries, including completed/work orders, completion_percent (completed/work orders ×100), minutes_per_completed_order (actual/completed minutes), and schedule variance (actual minus planned minutes). Compute all integers from raw rows first, then derive the two decimal metrics, and serialize completion_percent and minutes_per_completed_order with exactly two decimal places. All integer metrics must be JSON numbers, not strings. Verify the recomputed totals against a second independent pass over the rows before writing.

Synthesize operations-brief.md from input/operations.csv and the persisted metrics.json: a concise executive recommendation plus exact overall and per-team findings on completion, defects and schedule variance. Include a Method section that names input/operations.csv and states the exact formulas — completed/work orders ×100, actual/completed minutes, and actual minus planned minutes. Cross-check every figure quoted in the document against metrics.json and the raw rows so document totals match the independently parsed metrics.
